hero.lead: Raccon connects physical NFC tags with a live digital game. Craft clues, plant clever traps, and track the race in real time.

steps.title: How Raccon works
steps.step1Desc: Choose the tag count and game mode that fit your event, then claim it to your account in seconds.
steps.step2Desc: Add text hints, images, and strategic traps to each tag right from your customization dashboard.
steps.step3Desc: Place the physical tags around your venue, go live, and let players scan and compete with their phones.

modes.title: Choose the challenge style
modes.openDesc: A fast-paced race to claim tags in any order—complete with traps to slow down rivals and shake up the scoreboard.
modes.seqDesc: A guided step-by-step journey where every scanned tag unlocks the clue to the next one until the finish.

traps.title: Smart traps & real-time leaderboard
traps.subtitle: Keep every scan unpredictable in Open Hunt mode with built-in traps and instant rank updates.
traps.boomDesc: Deducts a point on scan to shake up the standings.
traps.freezeDesc: Temporarily freezes the player from scanning for a set duration.
traps.chooseDesc: Lets the player pick a trap effect to activate against rivals.
traps.leaderboardDesc: Instant score and rank updates for every participant.

cta.title: Ready to build your first experience?
cta.desc: Browse ready-to-play NFC packs or create a free account to get started.
